phases.name: Foundation and AI providers
phases.goal: Contracts, config, DB, migrations, parser, grounding verifier and provider adapter that every stream builds on.
acceptanceCriteria: Migrations versioned and tested (D3)
package.json with zero dependencies (D2)
Notes parser and grounding verifier unit-tested (D4)
Validated structured output, injection-safe prompt, timeouts and malformed output handled (D4, D5)

phases.name: Core backend
phases.goal: HTTP, auth, RBAC, audit, notes, verifier, domain routes and API tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Consistent error envelope (D2, D5)
Access control and IDOR proven (D6)
API journey and persistence tests pass (D3, D7)

phases.name: Eval datasets and harness
phases.goal: Datasets, thresholds, runner, scorer and deterministic eval tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Thresholds fixed and tested before tuning; holdout manifest guarded; fallback and CLI evaluated separately (D8)

phases.name: Frontend and browser tests
phases.goal: Responsive accessible UI proven in real Chromium at 360 and 1280 px.
acceptanceCriteria: Screens, states, keyboard and citation highlighting implemented (D1)
Browser journey passes at both widths with evidence screenshots (D1, D7)

phases.name: Live verification, evals and docs
phases.goal: Live CLI provider tests, measured holdout results, then README and clean-checkout verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Live CLI path verified in this environment (D4)
Eval results reported against fixed thresholds (D8)
Setup, run, test and eval reproducible from README (D9)
Open risks listed (D10)

tasks.title: Package, config, schema validator, contract schemas, DB layer and migrations
acceptanceCriteria: package.json has engines node>=22.5, type module, zero dependencies, all scripts from spec section 11 with --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning (D2)
Versioned migrations 001/002 apply on fresh DB, second run is a no-op, edited or newer DB aborts (D3)
Audit trigger blocks UPDATE/DELETE; role/state/status constraints and foreign keys enforced
Contract schemas module is the single source of request/response shapes

tasks.title: Notes parser and deterministic grounding verifier with unit tests
acceptanceCriteria: Parser supports the three formats, physical line numbers in errors, limits enforced (D5)
Verifier implements reason codes, normalisation, stoplist v1 and union-of-cited-lines rules; pure, idempotent, no input mutation (D4)
Stoplist written before any model output; benchmark test passes

tasks.title: HTTP core, app wiring, auth, sessions, CSRF, limiter, RBAC, users, audit, static server, seed, test harness
acceptanceCriteria: Single error envelope with X-Request-Id; 404/405/413/415/500 shaped per contract and internals never leaked (D2, D5)
scrypt salted hashes; HttpOnly SameSite cookies; session rotation at login; idle and absolute expiry; double-submit CSRF plus Origin check (D6)
Login limiter: 6th attempt gives 429 with Retry-After even with right password; bounded memory (D6)
Audit log written for sensitive actions; lead-only team-scoped endpoint (D6)
src/routes/index.js auto-registers every other src/routes/*.js so later tasks add routes without editing app.js
Seed script is idempotent and creates teams Platform and Payments with lead/responder/viewer each plus a sample incident (D9)
Static server sets security headers and rejects traversal

verification.command: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --test "test/unit/auth/**/*.test.js" test/api/auth.test.js test/api/csrf.test.js test/api/static.test.js test/api/logs.test.js test/api/limits.test.js

tasks.title: AI draft schema, prompt builder, provider adapter, CLI/Anthropic/fallback/fake providers with unit tests
acceptanceCriteria: Narrow provider interface; DraftJSON strictly validated, extra fields rejected (D4)
CLI provider uses exact pinned argv (safe-mode, tools empty, no --bare), allowlisted env without API key, empty temp cwd removed afterwards; handles timeout, malformed output, flood, ENOENT (D4, D5)
Anthropic provider works against a local fake including 429/500/slow (D4)
Notes passed as escaped data block; payload cannot break out of delimiters (prompt-injection resistance, D4)
Fallback extractor deterministic (byte-identical runs), schema-valid, labelled isFallback (D4)
fake.js yields deterministic flagged and clean drafts for browser tests

tasks.title: Incidents, notes, drafts, publish transaction and postmortem routes with API integration tests
inputs: SCOPE.md D3 D4 D5 D6 D7
outputs: incident, notes, draft, postmortem, provider routes
acceptanceCriteria: Journey sign in -> incident -> notes -> draft -> publish refused with UNGROUNDED_STATEMENTS -> fix -> publish -> viewer reads passes as API test (D7)
Publish runs in BEGIN IMMEDIATE and re-verifies; tampered statuses and interleaved edit/publish never publish a flagged statement (D4, D6)
Provider timeout, malformed output, outage return documented codes and store nothing (D5)
IDOR matrix: cross-team access returns 404 and leaves data unchanged; viewers see only own team published postmortems; only leads publish (D6)
Data survives in-process reopen and spawned-process restart (D3)
Fallback draft marked isFallback in API (D4)

tasks.title: Tune incident/injection datasets, verifier corpus and thresholds test
acceptanceCriteria: 12 tune incidents (40-120 lines, gold timeline 6-15, actions 2-6) and 10 tune injection cases with unique canaries (D8)
verifier/fabrications.json >= 60 entries with expected codes; correct.json >= 150; forbidden-stopwords.txt
thresholds.json equals brief values and test asserts it (D8)
Synthetic data only

tasks.title: Holdout datasets with SHA-256 manifest and manifest test
acceptanceCriteria: 12 holdout incidents and 10 holdout injection cases, authored independently of the prompt and extractor (D8)
MANIFEST.sha256 lists every holdout file; test fails on missing, extra or changed files
Files are not read by backend-engineer or ai-engineer (holdout read-restricted)

tasks.title: Eval runner, scorer, budget guard, reports (fallback and CLI separate)
acceptanceCriteria: --provider mandatory; fallback and CLI reports never mixed (D8)
Metrics M1-M5 scored as spec 8.3 with Wilson intervals and exit codes 0/1/2/3/64

Budget guard refuses over-cap runs; usage printed and logged; holdout cap of 2 runs per provider and manifest check (D8) (one holdout run planned; the second slot is reserved for a disclosed harness defect)
Report prints thresholds notice, CLI version, model and cost; CLI absent gives NOT_RUN

verification.method: run verifier corpus and fallback eval on tune set
verification.command: npm run eval -- --verifier && npm run eval -- --provider fallback

tasks.title: Eval tests inside npm test: scorer, fallback tune, verifier corpus
acceptanceCriteria: Scorer tested with hand-built outputs including worst-run rule, Wilson values, INCOMPLETE/NOT_RUN and budget guard refusals (D8)
Verifier catches 100% of fabrications with expected code and <=2% false flags (D8)
Fallback meets tune thresholds, deterministic, injection 10/10 (D8)

tasks.title: Responsive vanilla JS UI: sign in, incidents, notes, draft review with citation highlighting, publish, postmortems
acceptanceCriteria: Screens for sign in, incidents, notes import, draft review, publish, postmortem read with loading, empty, error and success states (D1)
Usable 360-1440 px, no horizontal overflow, 44 px touch targets at 360 (D1)
Keyboard operable with visible focus (outline >= 2 px), skip link, live region for citation highlight (D1)
Clicking a citation highlights, scrolls to and focuses the source line; flagged statements show Not grounded with reasons; Publish disabled while flagged (D1, D4)
Fallback banner shown when isFallback; no inline scripts; user text rendered via textContent (XSS safe)
data-testid list from spec 7.3 implemented
node:test asserts every spec 7.3 data-testid exists in public/; D1 layout, focus, touch-target and state evidence is deferred to browser-e2e

verification.method: syntax check plus data-testid presence test

tasks.title: Real Chromium Playwright journey at 360 and 1280 px
acceptanceCriteria: Full journey incl. flagged statement, citation highlight, edit, lead publish, viewer read, cross-team empty state passes at 360 and 1280 px (D1, D7)
Keyboard, focus width, contrast, overflow, touch target and console error checks pass
XSS probe displays literally; test fails rather than skips if Chromium cannot launch
Screenshots saved as evidence

tasks.title: Live CLI tests, verifier/prompt tuning on tune set only, CLI and fallback holdout runs
acceptanceCriteria: Live CLI isolation test shows init tools exactly [StructuredOutput] and no permission denials (D4)
Live provider generation and CLI e2e journey pass with the real claude -p provider (D4, D7)

Agent-spend budget: live-eval provider spend aggregate cap <= USD 8 (tightens the design's USD 40 upper bound), at most 3 tune CLI runs, per-run cap USD 1.5; if cumulative harness spend exceeds USD 36 (planned pre-live cumulative about 31 plus 15%) before a live run, stop and report to the orchestrator; hard stop at USD 51 (85% of the USD 60 harness budget) (D8)

Exactly one holdout CLI run and one holdout fallback run; a second run per provider only after a documented harness defect, disclosed in holdout-runs.log and the report; results reported as measured, never retried for a pass (D8)

Every edit to src/ai/prompt.js, src/ai/fallback.js or src/verify/stopwords.js is recorded in eval/tuning-log.md (stopwords.js is backend-owned in spec section 11; edits go only through the tuning log)
After the last tuning change: npm test and npm run test:browser green, M1b 100% and M1c <=2% re-run and reported, fallback-tune and determinism tests pass
Every run uses a small model and prints usage

verification.method: live tests plus full regression after last tuning change
verification.command: npm run test:live && npm test && npm run test:browser && npm run eval -- --verifier

tasks.title: README, config and secrets docs, rollback notes, clean-checkout run
acceptanceCriteria: README covers prerequisites, config variables, seed logins, run, test, browser test prerequisite, live and eval commands with budget rules, reading eval reports, privacy note, limitations, troubleshooting (D9)
Every documented command was run and works; a clean checkout copy passes npm test (D9)
Known risks and limitations listed (D10)
Eval results and cost rules in README quote the final live-eval reports; clean-checkout npm test run after the last tuning change (D9)
